title: Ellsworth silo abandoned with access plug open
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ellsworth silo abandoned with access plug open, about 1978 at Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: And in 1978, one year after Mario and Michael, a security team at the base abandoned a silo with the access plug open

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1978, at Ellsworth, an Air Force base in South Dakota with underground nuclear missile silos, a security team left a silo with its access plug, the heavy lid over the entrance, standing open. He places it one year after an earlier case involving two men he calls Mario and Michael, and tells it as part of a pattern of strange events at nuclear missile sites.
